description: This is an abstract class definition for an AWS SDK cryptographic client, defining supported ciphers, key wraps, security profiles, and abstract methods for cipher handling and encryption/decryption streams within the Awsypto namespace.

classes.name: AbstractCryptoClientV2
classes.description: An internal abstract class providing cryptographic operations and configurations for AWS SDK, including cipher support, encryption, and decryption methods.

methods.name: isSupportedCipher
methods.description: Checks if a given cipher name is supported for encryption by the SDK.

methods.name: getCipherOpenSslName
methods.description: Abstract method to return the openssl cipher name for given cipher and key size.

methods.name: buildCipherMethod
methods.description: Abstract method to construct a CipherMethod object for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: getCipherFromAesName
methods.description: Abstract method for reverse lookup of openssl cipher name from AES name.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Abstract method to create an encryption stream with provided data and encryption materials.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Abstract method to create a decryption stream with ciphertext and metadata.
